info.title: Homeservice financial finalization
info.description: Lead-selected step5C v1.0.0 A/C/B contract. A HTTP validation/client/callers are implemented as explicit injection seams. Production remains unwired: C durable financial participant/Booking work/recovery and B real verification are required. Schema and fixture checks do not prove runtime atomicity/auth/recovery.

servers.description: Payments origin. Financial HTTP routes are mounted but fail closed without the required real verifier/participant.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Must equal complete:<body.operation_id>; persist once and reuse unchanged.

200.description: Validated durable ready result; identical terminal replay returns the same result.

202.description: Durably accepted pending operation. No financial success/final cancellation inferred.

409.description: Durable attention or coded conflict. Uncoded conflict is reconciliation, never a confirmed cancellation.

post.description: Service-to-service only; Booking owns trusted immutable context. Additional cross-field identity/arithmetic constraints are in the handoff and reference validator. No HTTP is performed inside local SQL transactions.

200.description: Successful lookup, NOT financial success: inspect state ready/pending/attention.

404.description: Unknown for this stable caller. Do not infer failure or safe release; retry/query original operation.

200.description: Authenticated callback receipt/effect transaction completed; no duplicate charge/outbox.

404.description: Unknown gateway reference; no effect committed.

409.description: Changed event payload, cancellation fence or other consistency conflict; never acknowledge as success.

post.description: Preserve public callback path/payload. This Payments route is not mounted. B supplies mock-gateway authentication, distinct from Booking/customer. Unsupported type is rejected; retry the same gateway event ID.

servers.description: Monolith origin; this projection is only for the future financial mode.

409.description: Illegal local state/OTP/ownership transition or reconciliation required.

200.description: Booking completed with authoritative accounting_status; pending is not payout confirmation.

post.description: No browser-supplied financial command ID or money. Booking persists its operation UUID/key once; retries must recover that work. Cookie-based browser credentials require B integration; this contract illustrates bearer API clients.

servers.description: Monolith origin; this projection is only for the future financial mode.

409.description: Illegal transition or cancellation attention; do not release slots from an untyped conflict.

200.description: Cancelled only after safe Payments acknowledgement; refunded is confirmed, not guessed.

202.description: Cancellation pending; original order/slots retained. No refunded field.

post.description: No browser-supplied financial command ID or money. Booking persists its operation UUID/key once; retries must recover that work. Cookie-based browser credentials require B integration; this contract illustrates bearer API clients.

requestBody.description: No body or an empty JSON object only; no browser money/owner/work fields.

serviceBearer.description: B verified Booking service principal; audience payments-wallet-service and exact operation permission.

gatewayBearer.description: Dedicated mock-gateway bearer credential verified by B callback verifier. No customer/Booking-token or legacy-secret fallback; B owns token validation and principal provisioning.

endUserBearer.description: B verified customer/provider API credentials; browser session/delegation wiring remains integration work.

X-Request-Id.description: Correlation only; never the command identity.

Error403.description: Verified caller lacks the operation permission

Error500.description: Sanitized unexpected error; financial outcome remains unknown

Error503.description: Runtime/auth/participant or dependency unavailable; outcome is unknown

x-requirements: Reject nonempty unknown query fields and unknown body fields; command/webhook bodies limited to16KiB.
Operation/key equality, complete request echo and completion arithmetic require explicit validators beyond OpenAPI structural validation.
Pending results may progress under the same saved command. Ready result and financial effects replay unchanged; request identity never changes.
POST200 means ready; POST202 means durable pending; GET200 only means lookup succeeded.
No gateway legacy intent without reviewed provisioning references is adopted by v1. No fabricated references for COD or imported legacy data.
A/C schema and importer/startup review is mandatory before activation; this contract supplies no new persistence.
